data.answer: Nimbus Labs holds a current SOC 2 Type II report for the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform. The audit period covered ran from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026.
Yes, TLS certificates are issued by a public certificate authority and are renewed automatically 30 days before they expire.
Yes, customer administrators can connect their own SAML 2.0 identity provider to Nimbus Ledger Sync.
Yes, account numbers and UPI identifiers are additionally encrypted at the field level before being written to the database. All customer data is also encrypted at rest with AES-256.

After a contract ends, customer data stays available for export for 90 days. Once that window closes, data is deleted from production systems within 30 days, and backups expire on their normal 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.
In an incident, the on-call engineer may take emergency production access for up to 2 hours without prior approval. The Engineering Manager must approve it retrospectively within 24 hours.

Nimbus Labs reports to CERT-In within 6 hours of becoming aware of a reportable cyber incident, as required by Indian rules. Affected customers are notified within 72 hours when a breach involving customer data is confirmed.
An external penetration test is performed once a year by CertiNova. The most recent test took place in March 2026.
